subject.title: Dashboard: inter-widget pub/sub — a tab-scoped message bus

question: Should OpenClaw accept a tab-scoped widget pub/sub bus as part of the bundled dashboard bridge once the linked PR proves same-tab delivery and cross-tab isolation?
rationale: The request adds a new widget-to-widget communication capability on top of sandboxed/custom dashboard widgets, so final acceptance depends on maintainer product and security intent rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Review the linked PR first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked PR to resolve its lifecycle/security blockers, dependency/stack state, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the apps-layer capability
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but pause pub/sub until the modular dashboard foundation has landed and been validated in real use.

options.title: Reject dashboard widget pub/sub
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR if maintainers decide explicit inter-widget communication should not be part of the bundled dashboard boundary.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked PR to resolve its lifecycle/security blockers, dependency/stack state, and real behavior proof before merge.
